    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Card
    Model class representing a trading card in the TCG application.
    CardController
    Controller responsible for handling card-related HTTP requests.
    CardDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Card entities.
    Deck
    Model class representing a deck of cards in the TCG application.
    DeckController
    Controller responsible for handling deck-related HTTP requests.
    DeckDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Deck entities.
    HomeController
    Controller responsible for handling the home page and static informational pages.
    ImplCardBD
    JDBC-based implementation of the CardDAO interface.
    ImplDeckBD
    JDBC-based implementation of the DeckDAO interface.
    ImplPlayerBD
    JDBC-based implementation of the PlayerDAO interface.
    ImplStatsBD
    JDBC-based implementation of the StatsDAO interface.
    Player
    Model class representing a player in the TCG application.
    PlayerController
    Controller responsible for handling player-related HTTP requests.
    PlayerDAO
    Data Access Object interface for Player entities.
    ServletInitializer
    Servlet initializer for deploying the TCG application to an external servlet container.
    ShopController
    Controller responsible for handling all shop-related HTTP requests.
    StatsDAO
    Data Access Object interface for retrieving game statistics.
    TcgApplication
    Main entry point for the TCG (Trading Card Game) Spring Boot application.
    WebConfig
    Web MVC configuration class for the TCG application.
